item.title: Jinmonkan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Deeper
  • 発売日: 2004-10-01
  • スコア: 6.4799999999999995/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 尋問姦 -じんもんかん-
  • 英語名: Jinmonkan

あらすじ

Lingas is a country 5 years after defeat in the war. The population reluctantly accepts the defeat, but military police still sets raids deal with terrorism and riots. Main character is a head of one such unit. One day squad gets attacked by rebel organization leading to numerous casualties. Protagonist soon finds the leader - it’s the journalist woman. He has three weeks to get evidence from her.

あらすじ

Main character starts to live with his uncle after parents’ death in a traffic accident. Uncle is a pastor who has close ties with the underworld. Under threat of losing life protagonist follows uncle training for three years, and now it’s time for him to teach cute lambs the teachings of God by himself…
